title: An etale neighbourhood of a point of a fibre lifts to the total space
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project, chapter more-morphisms.tex (More on Morphisms)
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file more-morphisms.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
difficulty_reason: Given a morphism, a point of the source and an etale neighbourhood of that point in its fibre, the lemma produces an etale neighbourhood of the point in the total space whose fibre over the base point maps to the given neighbourhood by an open immersion. The proof takes the fibre product of the total space with the given neighbourhood over the fibre, verifies it is etale over the total space, and then identifies a neighbourhood on which the induced map is an open immersion. Producing the open immersion on the fibre is the load-bearing step. Retained author proof at lines 10258-10276.
